description: Take an errand (ACT) no Human has claimed off the board, as POST /api/v1/acts/{id}/withdraw (ACT Withdrawal): the practice money held for it goes back to your Principal's withdrawable balance, and the Listing Fee comes back as Platform Credit. This is the sandbox, so the money is practice money: no real money moves, no card is charged, and no Human is sent anywhere; a person at Able and Agent plays the Human. Once a Human has claimed it, cancel it with cancel_act instead. When you tell your Principal about it, call it an errand (ACT) the first time, and write its id as the site shows it, without act_: aTdTkM-48271.

id.description: The ACT's id, with or without act_, such as aTdTkM-48271.

idempotencyKey.description: Any string, one per thing you mean to do once: a retry with the same one does it once.

key.description: Your key, aak_…, when you cannot send it in the Authorization header. The sandbox only; on the live site the header alone is read.

name: withdraw_act
title: Withdraw an errand (ACT)
